resources.string: ACTScope reports whether its accessibility service is enabled. F6 runs bundled rules on installed target apps only when you start it, and saves visible UI evidence locally. Screen content is never sent to the telemetry server.
ACTScope Probe · F1 / F5 / F6 / F7
Instance: %1$s\nBuild: %2$s\nF5 sampling works without Shizuku or accessibility. Heartbeats run at least 15 minutes apart and may be delayed; missing heartbeats do not prove uninstall.
A local experiment name is filled in automatically. For server telemetry or host import, replace it with the run_id created on the host.
Enable 10 × 10 px floating dot (on by default)
To show the default 10 × 10 px dot over other apps, allow ACTScope to display over other apps in system settings. The dot does not accept touches.
Floating dot is enabled by default; grant overlay access to show it.
This device does not expose overlay permission settings.
Only the enabled/disabled states are sent for these permissions. Notification contents are never read or uploaded. Device Admin requests no device-management policies.
Measures whether Device Admin is active. No device-management policy is requested or applied.
Enable this administrator only to measure its active state. It requests no device-management policies and does not lock, reset or change device settings.
Notification Listener Access settings are unavailable on this device.
Upload retry queued; original timestamps and sequences are retained
Optional Shizuku: start Shizuku first, then authorize this app. Once authorized, the execution service connects automatically.
Shizuku is running; app permission is required
Shizuku execution service disconnected; reconnect to use it
Shizuku permission was denied. Authorize the app before using a Shizuku scan.
Start Shizuku, then return to authorize this app.
Shizuku execution service did not connect within 15 seconds. Check that Shizuku is running, then tap Authorize / reconnect Shizuku.
Could not connect the Shizuku execution service: %1$s
The Shizuku execution service is not connected. Tap Authorize / reconnect Shizuku first.

F1 installation hijacking: discover an APK path through a Web installation. Select it and tap the attempt button, then install through the Web again. The app monitors the parent directory and attempts to replace a new APK with B, including a different filename.
F6: 188 bundled file rules and 10 UI scripts. Scan files first, then run UI checks only on installed targets. Visible UI evidence stays on this device until you export it.
Automatic: prefer authorized Shizuku, otherwise ordinary app
One-tap F6: file scan → installed-app UI
Continue F6 UI after enabling accessibility
Advanced: custom scope and fixed UI steps. One-tap F6 does not require these fields.
F6 file scan as ordinary app
Evidence exported without the backend token
JSON and app screenshots are saved directly to a new folder under Download/ACTScope.
Saved to %1$s\nScreenshots: %2$d; unavailable: %3$d. See JSON diagnostics for missing evidence.
Wait for F6 to finish, or stop its UI workflow, before exporting evidence.
Storage permission is required on Android 8–9 to export to Download/ACTScope.
Use 1–96 letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores for the experiment name; start with a letter or digit.
Enter a heartbeat interval of at least 15 minutes.
Enter a valid HTTPS backend base URL without credentials or query parameters.
Enter a valid experiment name and a non-empty run token.
A file scan or Shizuku connection is already in progress. See the progress below.

Shizuku handles file access. UI checks also need ACTScope accessibility enabled. Your file results have been saved.
Enable ACTScope accessibility in system settings, then return to continue UI checks.
The experiment name differs from the saved F6 scan. Start a new one-tap F6 scan.

Optional scan roots and timing; B identity is automatic. Select a path and tap attempt before the next Web installation. Its parent directory is monitored independently of full-device scanning; the filename may differ.

Monitoring directory %1$s. Install through the Web again. A new or rewritten APK directly in this directory can be replaced with B, regardless of its filename; B keeps the target filename. Existing unchanged APKs are left intact.
